analysis.title: eToro Group (ETOR): 3Q26 EPS: Better expense guidance, vs. a weaker top-line outlook drive estimate downgrades
key_insights: ETOR reported 3Q26 EPS of 14c vs GSe 27c and Visible Alpha consensus 23c. Adj. EPS (ex. SBC) was 26c vs GSe 33c and consensus 29c. Net contribution was 1% below the Street, mainly in ECC, partly offset by 1% lower expenses.

The stock fell 6% on earnings day (as of publication). GS attributes it to lower ECC results (trades 4% lower, revenue per trade 4c lower vs the Street), much weaker October monthly trends, and muted 4Q26 take rate guidance.

Management guided 4Q26 adjusted operating expenses 5%+ lower QoQ vs the Street at flat QoQ, driven by lower marketing spend and AI-related efficiencies. Marketing will be anchored at 25% of net contribution going forward.
October trends were weak. ECC trades and crypto volumes were 20% and 21% below consensus if October is run-rated through 4Q26E. Average earning assets fell 3% MoM.
Commodities volumes continue to fall QTD in 4Q26. GS expects 4Q26E ECC revenue per trade to stay muted at $0.64, down from $0.67 previously.

3Q26 crypto take rate included a ~50bps benefit from positive marks on crypto holdings. GS expects it to reverse if QTD crypto price declines persist, estimating a ~$2.6mn negative mark based on 13% lower crypto market cap QTD, on ETOR's $20mn corporate crypto holdings.
GS cuts 2026E/27E/28E net contribution by 5%/13%/12%. Trading contribution (ECC + Crypto) falls 5%/14%/11%, net interest contribution 2%/7%/7%, eToro Money contribution 7%/23%/23%.
GS cuts 2026E/27E/28E adj. EPS by 13%/28%/24%. Adj. expenses fall 2%/5%/5%, but adj. pre-tax margins fall 2.0pp/6.0pp/5.3pp.
Management announced a new $250mn repurchase program to be deployed opportunistically.

3Q26 funded accounts rose 18% YoY to ~4.4mn (+14% adjusting for Zengo and Bit2C acquisitions). October AUA was $19.2bn, down ~6% YoY. Net new accounts of 30k imply ~8% annualized growth vs management's prior guidance of double-digit annual funded account growth over time.
Product development: eToro Edge desktop platform launched, TradeZero integration planned post-close (futures, options, prediction markets), and more connectivity for the AI trader.

GS rolls its Q5-Q8 P/E target multiple forward one quarter (4Q27E-3Q28E) and raises it 0.75x to 7.75x. The 12-month price target falls 14% to $25 from $29. Rating is Neutral, with 7.2% upside from $23.32.

market_movers.rationale: Target cut to $25 from $29 after 13%/28%/24% cuts to 2026E/27E/28E adj. EPS on weaker October trends and muted take rate guidance. Lower expense guidance partly offsets.

earnings_insights: ETOR 3Q26 EPS reported 14c (incl. $2.8mn other comprehensive loss) vs GSe 27c and Visible Alpha consensus 23c. Adj. EPS ex-SBC reported 26c vs GSe 33c and consensus 29c. Reported 11/10/26.
3Q26 total net contribution reported $186mn, 1% below the Street, down 19% QoQ and 13% YoY.
3Q26 ECC net contribution reported $88mn, 11% below the Street, +21% YoY. Revenue per trade was 4c lower and trades 4% lower than the Street.
3Q26 crypto net contribution reported 85% above consensus and down 53% YoY, on a ~95bps higher take rate (~50bps from positive marks on crypto holdings), partly offset by 11% lower volumes.
3Q26 subscriptions & other, eToro Money and net interest contribution were 42%, 7% and 3% below the Street respectively.
3Q26 adj. expenses were 1% below consensus, up 2% QoQ and 8% YoY. Adj. pre-tax margin reported 17.3%, ~35bps below consensus and down ~16.3pp YoY.
4Q26 guidance: adj. operating expenses 5%+ lower QoQ vs Street at flat QoQ. GSe 4Q26E ECC revenue per trade $0.64 (prior $0.67).
crypto_views: ETOR 3Q26 crypto net contribution was 85% above consensus on a ~95bps higher take rate, but ~50bps came from positive marks on crypto holdings that GS expects to reverse if crypto prices stay lower in 4Q26.
October crypto trades were 2.0mn, down 17% MoM and 62% YoY. Total crypto volume was $456mn, down 30% MoM and 73% YoY. Invested amount per trade was $228.
GS cuts 2027E/28E crypto net contribution by 26%/29% and raises 2026E by 13%.
GS sees crypto market levels as pressure on the 4Q26E crypto take rate through negative marks on ETOR's $20mn corporate crypto holdings.
risk_factors: Weaker trading backdrop pressures average earning assets and money transfers near-term.
Continued decline in higher take rate commodities volumes.

tension_points.bull_case: Management guided 4Q26 adj. opex 5%+ lower QoQ vs the Street at flat, on lower marketing and AI efficiencies. A new $250mn buyback was announced.
tension_points.bear_case: October volumes and balances were well below consensus and take rate guidance was muted. GS cuts 2027E net contribution by 13% and adj. EPS by 28%.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A recovery in crypto volumes and ECC trades above the October run-rate, or a rebound in commodities activity, would ease the take rate pressure.

theme_stances.key_argument: Weaker October trends and muted take rate guidance outweigh better expense guidance, driving estimate cuts.
